title: C link layer: implement selected relay signer key-selection
description: Align lichen C link/L2 RX key resolution with the selected option. PENDING project-LICHEN-worker6-nxew. Current: peer_try_all_pubkeys (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_peer.c:118) does O(N) constant-time trial-verify over the provisioned peer table; SIID<->canonical-EUI64 binding happens post-match (lichen_link_rx.c:196-203). If option (b): add SIID-indexed lookup into the peer/TOFU cache keyed by canonical EUI-64 (single Schnorr-48 verify per frame), normative relay-neighbor TOFU population, keep fail-closed behavior and pre-verify state-allocation ban; document or preserve constant-time properties. If option (a): change frame.c/schnorr48.c transcript and parsers for truncated signer ID. If option (c): implement two-hop chain verification. Acceptance: host CMake tests (lichen/tests: frame, replay, schnorr48) pass with ASan/UBSan; new fail-closed tests for wrong-key, pinned-mismatch, multi-hop relay; no pre-verify replay/trust state allocation.
notes: Uncommitted implementation in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_internal.h and lichen_l2_peer.c. New l2_key_selection test directory (untracked) with CMakeLists.txt and main.c (~20KB). Changes implement SIID-indexed key selection (option b) per spec/02-physical-link.md 4.2.
close_reason: Option (b) implemented per nxew decision: O(N) trial-verify replaced by SIID-indexed peer_find_locked() + single Schnorr-48 verify (67 production diff lines). Accept-set proven identical to old scheme (binding gate in lichen_link_rx.c:190-203 unchanged, load-bearing). Fail-closed on unknown SIID, no pre-verify state allocation, replay commits only post-auth, TOFU pinning + LRU eviction + REPLAY_PERSIST refusal preserved, timing documented. New lichen/tests/l2_key_selection suite (6 fail-closed tests: wrong-key, decoy-valid-sig, pinned-mismatch, unknown SIID, no-pre-verify-allocation, multi-hop relay re-sign). frame/replay/schnorr48 all pass. Wave review: no P0-P2 in work product; coverage gaps + pre-existing stub-abort + keying invariant gap filed as beads.
